You do dream. Everyone does. You just don't remember them.

If you want to start remembering dreams there are a few things you can do.

1) make sure you're getting at least 8 hours a night

2) don't drink alcohol or smoke pot

3) don't eat 3-4 hours before going to sleep

4) set alarms every 90 minutes after you go to sleep (use sleepytime.me to figure out your intervals) this makes you more likely to remember dreams because you will be "interrupting" your cycles with brief periods of waking consciousness

5) go to sleep in each interval with the expressed intention (autos suggestion) of remembering your dream. Go to bed repeating in your head "I will remember my dream tonight..." until you pass out.

6) start a dream journal. As soon as you wake up, without flipping on the lights or checking your phone, write down anything you can remember, a color a feeling and person.. Even if its faint brief or barely remembered. Do this immediately.

You will start to remember your dreams you just need to cultivate a daily interest in it.
